objective: The owner's request of 2026-11-25 that the thread work through its four top-valued directions in parallel; this is the second (sub-goals B261 and B269; goals G1 and G2 with G5). A space with a dimension needs the number of knots within reach r of a knot to grow like a fixed power of r (dimension as the growth rate of that count). The record already counts knots by round (lesson 8.2 of the guide: for the kinds of fixed dimension the knots made up to round t number about a power of t) and has one count within reach proved (from one knot under a fixed count of three fresh distinctions for every birth, the distinctions within bond distance r grow as the cube of r; 17 and 18 November 2026). What no study has counted is the knots within r holder steps of a knot away from the start (around made knots and around members), under the laws in balance and the laws that let parts meet, and whether one power holds around every knot. The questions: in the structures the recorded growth laws make, how does the number of live knots within r steps of a knot grow with r, and under which law and start is it a fixed power and under which faster than any power; and does the growing end carry a distance of its own, that is, do the loose distinctions of two live knots disagree at rates that follow how far apart the knots are? First step: the count within reach at successive rounds under ordinary growth, the laws in balance and the two recorded rival joins, on the starts of the ring that returns and on sampled starts under a named weighting; and the pencil statement of B269 (under parity every pair of loose distinctions disagrees half the time, so the growing end has no distance) proved or refuted. Stop at the growth of the count in each case (a power with its exponent and the range it was read on, or faster than any power) and, for the growing end, at a law that holds on every reached stage examined or the smallest reached stage where order by state distance and order by delay disagree. Standard: the claim stated before it is tested; a frozen pre-registration reviewed cold by the advisor; an engine written from the frozen text by a helper who has not seen the prototype; the knot test on every knot made under parity and not-all-equal; every added rule, weighting and hand-built start named as a scaffold and swapped; supplied or made said plainly; nothing called typical, rare or likely without its weighting; no claims about physics, physical time, living things or minds; every new word checked with the advisor.
title: How many knots lie within reach, and whether the growing end carries a distance of its own
